Lomi Lomi Salmon
By: Desiree Mellon
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 4:56pm

Ingredients




1 pound Salted Salmon chopped or shredded
2 mediums Fresh firm but ripe tomatoes peeled & diced
1 medium green onion chopped finely
Chopped Parsley (optional)

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients together in a bowl with your hand until thoroughly mixed. Serve Chilled.

About


This is a traditional Hawaiian Luau dish. Go ahead and take your taste buds on a trip to Maui! Enjoy!
